prompt: IMPORTANT: the ginger cat MUST REMAIN A REAL PHOTOGRAPHED CAT in every frame - individual hairs, natural tabby fur, real whiskers, normal cat eyes. Never smooth, never glossy, never cartoonish, never a plush toy. It never turns into a person. Plain live television look: no sparks, no fire, no glowing effects, no cartoon effects. Bare knuckles with thin hand wraps only, no boxing gloves. Anatomy stays correct: no twisted joints, no rubbery limbs. Continuous single shot, no cuts, camera completely LOCKED on a tripod with only a tiny tremble; it does NOT zoom, push in, orbit or travel. Bare-knuckle boxing ring. NOBODY THROWS A SINGLE PUNCH in this shot. Timing, follow it exactly: SECONDS 0-2: the ginger cat is ENORMOUS - a head and a half taller than the female fighter, towering over her. She stands in front of it with her guard up, looking up at it. The cat stays that size in every frame. SECONDS 2-5: the cat slowly LEANS DOWN toward her, bending its neck, bringing its huge face right down to her level to look at her closely, curious, the way a cat inspects something small. Its whiskers almost touch her. She freezes, then lowers her fists and leans back away from the face. SECONDS 5-7: she takes a step backwards, stumbles over her own feet and sits down hard on the canvas, staring up. The cat does not touch her at all - she goes down entirely by herself, from backing away. SECONDS 7-8: the cat straightens back up to its full height, blinks slowly and licks one paw, completely uninterested. Shot on a long telephoto lens with shallow depth of field: the fighters and the ropes sharp, the crowd and the banners out of focus, no letters or logos legible behind the ring. The ring stays exactly as in the first frame. Do not invent or re-spell any text, no gibberish, no logos of any other fight promotion. Photorealistic. No blood, no injury, comedic tone. Audio: arena crowd murmuring, going quiet as the cat leans down, a few nervous laughs, then a thud as she sits down and the crowd bursts out laughing. No music, no commentary, no speech.
